metadata.engineering_distinction: CRITICAL DISTINCTION: These alignments represent verified real-world surface river channels (Khan and Saraswati rivers) and natural storm feeders surveyed in OpenStreetMap. They are maintained strictly separate from internal subsurface drainage culverts, pipe diameters, invert elevations, and municipal pump station telemetry.
